From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Intro + POC scope - Clearsight x Redwood

Thanks again for the time today - great discussion. Per our call, I wanted to capture the agreed POC scope, success criteria, and next steps so we have a shared checklist. Please reply with any edits.

POC goal (2 weeks): validate that Redwood reduces average inference latency for Clearsight's real-time scoring pipeline while keeping prediction parity (<=1% AUC delta) and reducing per-token cost by at least 30% under representative load.

Success criteria (agreed):
- Latency: p95 <= 200ms for 1-2k rps burst testing on provided sample traffic
- Quality: AUC drop <= 1% on the 50k sample evaluation set
- Cost: token unit cost reduction >= 30% vs current endpoint
- Stability: no service-restores > 5 minutes during the test window

Evaluation plan / deliverables:
- Clearsight provides: sample evaluation dataset (CSV), representative request traces, and an example inference container (if available) - owner: Sam (due: Jul 16)
- Redwood provides: POC environment, model onboarding, test harness for latency and AUC, and a short runbook for connections - owner: Marissa/Marcus (deliverables by Jul 17)
- Joint load test + evaluation run: target window Jul 20-21; results and short report by Jul 22

Access and security notes:
- We'll use a dedicated trial tenancy and mutual TLS for the test. We will share a short access file with instructions (redwood_trial_access.txt).

Next immediate actions:
1) Sam to drop the evaluation dataset and any network constraints (IP allowlist) by EOD Jul 16.
2) Redwood to share POC plan v2 and Drive link by Jul 16.
3) Schedule 30m kickoff (in-person optional) for Jul 17-18 - Marcus to propose times.

Attachments: clearsight_poc_plan_v2.pdf (draft), network_diagram.png (example).

Thanks - excited to get this rolling.

-
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
